topic: SehatFlow workflow: supplier invoice to report in one workspace
caption:
From supplier invoice to sales report, without switching tools. 💊

SehatFlow is the pharmacy management platform we designed and built in-house. Here's how a pharmacy's day flows through it:

▸ Purchasing: AI-assisted invoice import, so less manual typing
▸ Inventory: stock lives in the same workspace as sales
▸ Sales: a built-in drug interaction checker
▸ Reporting: on the same data, not a separate tool

One workspace instead of four disconnected ones.

Run a pharmacy? Take a look at sehatflow.com 🔗

Share this with a pharmacy owner you know. 🔁
